notes: `הִרְבָּה` takes *hath ... many* under rule 56's auxiliary-verb clause, keeping the clause's auxiliary as the finite verb, while `חֲלָלֵינוּ` keeps *slain* and its suffix takes *of us* headed on the pronoun (rule 19).
*And when* is one rendering of the opening waw (rule 55); the apodosis waw at s007 and the waw at s028 are `unrepresented` for want of any written connective (rule 14).
